I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-team message to confirm the date is noted: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 20 November.

Before replying, I checked the brain. Nothing I could see gives a different deadline. The search ran keyword-only, so it may have missed related notes that use different wording.

I didn't take any other action, since Ilse said none was needed. Their message is saved to the brain automatically. The deadline is a signing date, not a money term, so sharing it in the channel is fine.
